text:
maya: Ok team, EMEA partner roadshow in two weeks includes a joint demo with CloudHaven. They want a small booth experience: 'passport experiment' + live demo of model routing. Need: final passport layout owner, customs for EU hand-carry, and split swag pickup at our Amsterdam warehouse.

leo: I'll pull final layout from design and confirm bleed. Uploading demo_pass_final.pdf. Quick question: are we printing in English only? CloudHaven wants EN/NL.

sandra: We can do bilingual cover, interior EN. Swagbot: can you split sticker runs?

Swagbot: Split confirmed. 600 stickers NL/EN to AMS warehouse, 400 EN to CDG, 200 to LHR. Fulfillment ETA 5 days. Order 8812.

nick: For hand-carry: recommend carrying the demo appliance (1 unit) and the demo laptop. Need serials and value for temporary import. Airport security requires a letter on company letterhead. @warehouse-bot can we print two copies?

warehouse-bot: Copy request accepted. Letter templates stored in /ops/templates. Will print when FedEx pickup scheduled.

maya: Volunteers: need 2/day at booth and 1 dedicated tech for demo lane. @leo @sandra can you join roster?

leo: I can do Thursday AM.

sandra: I'll do Friday midday.

maya: Great. Also coordinate with CloudHaven for speaker swap. They want their CTO for 10min lightning talk inside our demo slot. Need a 15-min coordination call. @nick please schedule.

nick: Meeting scheduled with CloudHaven for Tue 14:00. Calendar invite sent.

maya: Final: I'll draft runbook and attach packing manifest. Please confirm serial numbers and insured values by EOD Monday. :sparkles:
